title: Enact Withholding Illegal Revenue Entering Drug Markets Act
subject: Commerce
Taxation

abstracts.abstract: To amend section 5747.98 and to enact sections 1315.131, 5502.80, and 5747.88 of the Revised Code to levy a transfer fee on certain money transmissions by customers who are not United States citizens or nationals, to authorize an income tax credit based on the amount of the transfer fees paid, and to name this act Ohio's Withholding Illegal Revenue Entering Drug Markets (WIRED) Act.
